children: Cybersecurity firm's fiscal Q4 revenue rose 34% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q4 beat analyst expectations
On September 1st, Company announced the acquisition of Console, an AI-native platform, to expand Cortex capabilities
Company sees Q1 2027 revenue of $3.3 bln to $3.31 bln
Palo Alto Networks expects FY27 revenue of $14.1 bln to $14.2 bln
Company expects FY27 non-GAAP operating margin of 29.5%
NEXT-GEN SECURITY ARR - Co said Q4 results were driven by 63% yr/yr growth in Next-Generation Security ARR
PLATFORM STRENGTH - Strength across Network & AI Security, Cortex, and Idira platforms fueled results, per CFO Dipak Golechha
AI PRIORITY TAILWINDS - Co said latest AI advancements elevated cybersecurity to CIO priority, providing durable tailwinds, per CEO Nikesh Arora
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 44 "strong buy" or "buy", 12 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is $380.00, about 0.6% below its August 31 closing price of $382.13
The stock recently traded at 93 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 72 three months ago
